sources.quote: COAT-CCC-YELLOW,Yellow chromate conversion coating on aluminium,CrVI

findings.why: The proposed yellow chromate conversion coating (COAT-CCC-YELLOW) contains hexavalent chromium (CrVI), a substance restricted by law. The current trivalent coating does not. The part is for the Nordhavn Fjell (PRG-Y). The documents do not name the market or the law, so a person should confirm the market restriction.

sources.quote: 5.2 A change of coating requires Nordhavn approval before the first shipment.
Part card BR-310, roof rail bracket for the Nordhavn Fjell (PRG-Y).

findings.why: BR-310 belongs to the Nordhavn Fjell program (PRG-Y), so Nordhavn's requirements apply. Changing the coating from trivalent to yellow chromate needs Nordhavn approval before the first shipment. No approval or deviation in force covers this change. DEV-125 covers packing only.
